jobs.make-all:
name: Application checks
    needs: [changes, platform-contracts, mac-runner, elixir-checks, claude-checks]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require a complete classification decision
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          CODE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.application }}
          CLAUDE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.claude }}
          ELIXIR_RESULT: ${{ needs.elixir-checks.result }}
          CLAUDE_RESULT: ${{ needs.claude-checks.result }}
          POLICY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.policy }}
          READY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.ready }}
          NPM: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.npm }}
          READINESS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.readiness }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.codex_config }}
          CONTRACTS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.contracts }}
          PROCESS_RESULT: ${{ needs.platform-contracts.result }}
          MAC_RUNNER_RESULT: ${{ needs.mac-runner.result }}
        run: |
          test "$RESULT" = success
          test "$MAC_RUNNER_RESULT" = success
          case "$CODE" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          case "$POLICY" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          for flag in "$CLAUDE" "$READY" "$NPM" "$READINESS" "$CONFIG" "$CONTRACTS"; do
            case "$flag" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          done
          if [ "$CODE" = true ] || [ "$CLAUDE" = true ]; then test "$POLICY" = true; fi
          for family in elixir claude; do
            if [ "$family" = elixir ]; then selected=$CODE; observed=$ELIXIR_RESULT;
            else selected=$CLAUDE; observed=$CLAUDE_RESULT; fi
            if [ "$selected" = true ] && [ "$READY" = true ]; then
              test "$observed" = success
            else
              test "$observed" = skipped
            fi
            if [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
              echo "$family family: selected=$selected, ready=$READY, result=$observed (success means executed; skipped means omitted or deferred)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            fi
          done
          if [ "$NPM" = true ] || [ "$READINESS" = true ] || [ "$CONFIG" = true ] || [ "$CONTRACTS" = true ]; then
            test "$POLICY" = true
          fi
          if [ "$NPM" = true ] || [ "$CONTRACTS" = true ]; then
            test "$PROCESS_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "$PROCESS_RESULT" = skipped
          fi
      - name: Check out source
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Workflow and metadata regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/tests -v

      - name: Validate all workflow and composite action definitions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        run: |
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz"
          echo "8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8  $RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" actionlint
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint" -shellcheck= -pyflakes=

      - name: Codex readiness regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.readiness == 'true'
        run: python3 runner/test_codex_readiness.py
      - name: Codex file and mount policy regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.codex_config == 'true'
        run: python3 scripts/ci/release_tests.py codex-config
      - name: Npm configuration semantics
        if: needs.changes.outputs.npm == 'true'
        run: python3 runner/test_npm_cache.py
      - name: Require ready application qualification
        env:
          APPLICATION: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.application }}
          CLAUDE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.claude }}
          READY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.ready }}
        run: |
          if { [ "$APPLICATION" = true ] || [ "$CLAUDE" = true ]; } && [ "$READY" = false ]; then
            echo 'Draft PR: affected application family qualification deferred; this required context remains non-passing until ready qualification succeeds.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Application qualification omission
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'false' && needs.changes.outputs.claude == 'false'
        run: echo "No application inputs changed; behavioral checks intentionally omitted, not executed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Documentation policy omission
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'false'
        run: echo "Human-facing documentation only; CI regression suites and workflow/toolchain setup intentionally omitted, not executed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
jobs.elixir-checks:
name: Elixir quality, build and full coverage
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Set up mise tools
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: jdx/mise-action@8418fedb1110381a0d3ba51a7a415d7c1b884550 # v5.2.2
        with:
          install: true
          cache: true
          working_directory: elixir

      - name: Cache deps and build
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            elixir/deps
            elixir/_build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('elixir/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-mix-

      - name: Verify full Elixir family
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        working-directory: elixir
        run: make elixir-ci
jobs.mac-runner:
name: Select owned Mac first for platform contracts
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 8
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.selected.outputs.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out source for owned-first capacity selection
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prove actual workflow-token capacity read before host preparation
        id: capacity-probe
        env:
          SELECT_TARGET_REQUESTED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.npm == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.contracts == 'true' }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SELECT_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/make-all.yml
          SELECT_JOB_KEY: platform-contracts
        run: python3 scripts/ci/mac_runner_request.py --probe >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Prefer prepared owned capacity; report pre-execution fallback
        id: selected
        env:
          SELECT_TARGET_REQUESTED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.npm == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.contracts == 'true' }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BACKUP_MAC_PERMIT: ${{ vars.SYMPHONY_BACKUP_MAC_PERMIT }}
          SELECT_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/make-all.yml
          SELECT_JOB_KEY: platform-contracts
        run: python3 scripts/ci/mac_runner_request.py >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

jobs.native-host-package:
name: Native helpers and fixtures (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes, qualification, host-policy, mac-runner]
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.qualification.result == 'success' && needs.host-policy.result == 'success' && needs.mac-runner.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.native == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.host-policy.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform == 'macos' && needs.mac-runner.outputs.runner || matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Require actual native Mac prerequisites
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        env:
          BACKUP_MAC_SELECTED: ${{ needs.mac-runner.outputs.runner != 'macos-14' }}
        run: |
          test "$(uname -s)/$(uname -m)" = Darwin/arm64
          python3 -c 'import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 11), "native Mac checks require Python 3.11+"'
          if [ "$BACKUP_MAC_SELECTED" = true ]; then
            case "$(sw_vers -productVersion)" in 14.*) ;; *) echo 'Backup guest must be macOS 14' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
          fi
      - name: Build actual native macOS ARM64 helper
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos' && needs.changes.outputs.package_macos == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-helper"
          bash scripts/release/build-host-helper.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-helper/symphony-host" --native
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-helper" && shasum -a 256 symphony-host > symphony-host.sha256)
      - name: Build actual static Linux x86-64 helper
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && needs.changes.outputs.package_linux == 'true'
        run: bash scripts/release/build-linux-host-helper.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-helper"
      - name: Native source-independent shared helper contracts
        if: ((matrix.platform == 'macos' && needs.changes.outputs.package_macos == 'true') || (matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && needs.changes.outputs.package_linux == 'true'))
        env:
          SYMPHONY_TEST_HOST_HELPER: ${{ runner.temp }}/host-helper/symphony-host
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          # Real local Docker proof on Linux; macOS hosted workers lack an engine.
          SYMPHONY_TEST_DOCKER_IMPORT: ${{ matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: |
          test "$("$SYMPHONY_TEST_HOST_HELPER" build-revision)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$("$SYMPHONY_TEST_HOST_HELPER" host-platform)" = "$PLATFORM"
          python3 scripts/package/test-package.py -v
          python3 scripts/package/test-selected-image.py -v
          python3 scripts/package/test-environment.py -v
          python3 scripts/package/test-manager-protocol.py -v
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/package/tests -p test_codex_config_store.py -v
      - name: Execute artifact in clean Ubuntu 26.04 without build tools
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && needs.changes.outputs.package_linux == 'true'
        env:
          HELPER: ${{ runner.temp }}/host-helper/symphony-host
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run --rm -v "$HELPER:/symphony-host:ro" -e EXPECTED_REVISION="$GITHUB_SHA" ubuntu:26.04 bash -euc '
            uname -sm
            cat /etc/os-release
            for tool in swift swiftc python3 node git mise elixir erl; do
              if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                printf "unexpected helper runtime dependency present: %s\n" "$tool" >&2
                exit 1
              fi
            done
            test "$(/symphony-host build-revision)" = "$EXPECTED_REVISION"
            test "$(/symphony-host hash-blob hello)" = b6fc4c620b67d95f953a5c1c1230aaab5db5a1b0
            mkdir -m700 /contract
            /symphony-host owned-directory /contract
            exec 8>>/contract/lock
            /symphony-host lock /contract/lock 8 acquire
            /symphony-host lock /contract/lock 8 inherited
          ' | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-helper/ubuntu26.log"
      - name: Prepare the real selected prior source
        if: inputs.previous_revision != ''
        env:
          PREVIOUS_REVISION: ${{ inputs.previous_revision }}
        run: bash scripts/release/prepare-candidate-source.sh "$PREVIOUS_REVISION" "$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper-source"
      - name: Build prior helper early on its actual supported native host
        if: inputs.previous_revision != ''
        env:
          PREVIOUS_REVISION: ${{ inputs.previous_revision }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper"
          source="$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper-source"
          helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper/symphony-host"
          if [ "$PLATFORM" = macos ]; then
            bash "$source/scripts/release/build-host-helper.sh" "$helper" --native
            (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper" && shasum -a 256 symphony-host > symphony-host.sha256)
            test "$(lipo -archs "$helper")" = arm64
          else
            bash scripts/release/build-linux-host-helper.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/prior-helper" "$source" "$PREVIOUS_REVISION"
          fi
          test "$("$helper" build-revision)" = "$PREVIOUS_REVISION"
          test "$("$helper" host-platform)" = "$PLATFORM"
          test "$("$helper" hash-blob hello)" = b6fc4c620b67d95f953a5c1c1230aaab5db5a1b0
          if [ "$PLATFORM" = linux_x86_64 ]; then
            SYMPHONY_TEST_HOST_HELPER="$helper" python3 "$source/scripts/package/test-package.py" -v
          fi
      - name: Retain artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: inputs.previous_revision != ''
        with:
          name: prior-native-host-helper-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ inputs.previous_revision }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/prior-helper/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Retain actual exact-source platform helper and qualification
        if: ((matrix.platform == 'macos' && needs.changes.outputs.package_macos == 'true') || (matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && needs.changes.outputs.package_linux == 'true'))
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: native-host-helper-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/host-helper/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Install native socket inspection utility
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux_x86_64' && needs.changes.outputs.fixtures == 'true'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lsof
      - name: Run native process and updater fixtures in the helper allocation
        if: needs.changes.outputs.fixtures == 'true'
        env:
          ORDINARY: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'push' && !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')) }}
        run: |
          uname -sm
          if [ "$ORDINARY" = true ]; then
            python3 scripts/ci/release_tests.py process
          else
            python3 scripts/ci/release_tests.py native
          fi
jobs.mac-runner:
name: Select owned Mac first for native host package
    needs: [changes, qualification, host-policy]
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.qualification.result == 'success' && (needs.host-policy.result == 'success' || (needs.changes.outputs.native == 'false' && needs.host-policy.result == 'skipped')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 8
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.selected.outputs.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out source for owned-first capacity selection
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prove actual workflow-token capacity read before host preparation
        id: capacity-probe
        env:
          SELECT_TARGET_REQUESTED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.package_macos == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.fixtures == 'true' }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SELECT_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/package-checks.yml
          SELECT_JOB_KEY: native-host-package
        run: python3 scripts/ci/mac_runner_request.py --probe >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Prefer prepared owned capacity; report pre-execution fallback
        id: selected
        env:
          SELECT_TARGET_REQUESTED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.package_macos == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.fixtures == 'true' }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BACKUP_MAC_PERMIT: ${{ vars.SYMPHONY_BACKUP_MAC_PERMIT }}
          SELECT_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/package-checks.yml
          SELECT_JOB_KEY: native-host-package
        run: python3 scripts/ci/mac_runner_request.py >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
